findings.summary: RESOLVED: onDeviceEnforced no longer hardcodes true on iOS; combined with the new network-probe.ts offline gate in App.tsx (blocks starting engine:'on-device' while network is reachable) and network_reachable_at_start logging, this closes the silent-fallback gap on both platforms with the only evidence a JS-level spike can actually produce (offline + recognized words = audio provably stayed on-device)

RESOLVED: the on-device enforcement/offline gate now applies only when config.engine === 'on-device'; network-engine control runs are allowed on every device regardless of Android API level or iOS on-device support
RESOLVED: 30s heartbeat event (App.tsx) plus maxHeartbeatGapSeconds in run-metrics.mjs gives a direct signal of OS-level process suspension, distinct from 'no more speech'; covered by new tests
RESOLVED: mergeRecognizedText's Android-per-sentence vs iOS-cumulative-final heuristic is now documented in README's analysis section

The offline proof for on-device runs is checked once at start() only, not continuously through a run; if the network reconnects mid-run (plausible during the plan's required background/locked-screen modes, e.g. auto-rejoining known WiFi after the screen wakes), nothing re-checks or logs it, so a mid-run silent fallback on iOS (or a pre-13 Android edge case) would not be caught by the log. Mitigated in practice by the README operator protocol (enable airplane mode for the whole on-device run), but not enforced or verified by the app itself. Suggest logging isNetworkReachable() periodically (e.g. alongside each heartbeat) so a reconnect during the run is visible in the JSONL rather than silently invalidating the run

Unchanged from the prior round: a late error/end from a just-dead session can still end the new session prematurely (handleError/handleEnd are guarded only by sessionEnded, not awaitingStart) — explicitly accepted in-code since the native module carries no session id; worst case is one extra logged restart cycle, not a text/WER corruption like the already-fixed result-merging bug
